summary: Chippewa County tower in Ruby Township, listed standing; a 2008 DNR job notice describes a 100-foot tower; build date and current status not found.

staffing.status: DNR advertised a lookout person position; the ad says most work is in April and May

events.note: Break-in reported at the Ruby tower on June 24, 1993; nothing missing, no damage. Chippewa Herald-Telegram item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page.
DNR advertised a lookout person position for the Ruby tower (ad dated January 27, 2008); applications due February 15, 2008. An advertisement only; hiring is not confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Build year, builder, design and current status were not found. The 100-foot height comes from a 2008 job notice, which does not say whether the figure is tower height or height to the cab; the record's 30.5 m matches. The FFLA listing is undated. Checked and not relevant: Wisconsin Historical Society records HI234014, HI234018 and HI234019 are other towers; towerdex.com returned 403. An unread OpenStreetMap node (357111641, 'Ruby Lookout Tower') tags a lattice observation tower at 134 m elevation; it could help confirm the structure type. Access and staffing unknown; no visit facts included.
